nodes.name: One-step hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: By adjusting the type of anions, NiFe LDH-A (A = CO₃²⁻, F⁻, Cl⁻) was prepared on NF by using a one–step hydrothermal method. Three samples show significantly different colors (Fig. S1†), visually indicating the mixed valences of the Ni and Fe elements.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ and NiFe LDH-F⁻ show conventional NiFe LDH phase (JCPDS: 40-0215) peaks at 11.4°, 23.0°, 34.4°, 39.0°, 60.0°, 61.3°; NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ shows different structure (JCPDS: 73-1520) peaks at 19.2°, 33.2°, 38.6°, 59.3°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: both NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ and NiFe LDH-F⁻ exhibit characteristic peaks of the conventional NiFe LDH phase (JCPDS: 40-0215) ... The XRD pattern of NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ shows the main peaks at 19.2°, 33.2°, 38.6°, and 59.3°, which perfectly match the (001), (100), (011), and (110) crystal planes.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ shows Ni 2p peaks at 855.3/872.9 eV (Ni²⁺), 856.7/875.2 eV (Ni³⁺) with Ni²⁺:Ni³⁺ = 1:0.66; Fe 2p peaks at 711.0/723.6 eV (Fe²⁺), 712.9/726.5 eV (Fe³⁺) with Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ = 0.93:1; O 1s shows no lattice oxygen O_L but more adsorbed oxygen O_ads.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The peaks located at 855.3 and 872.9 eV are attributed to Ni²⁺ 2p₃/₂ and Ni²⁺ 2p₁/₂ ... the Ni²⁺:Ni³⁺ values for NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ are 1:0.66 ... The introduction of Cl⁻ intercalation leads to an increase in the peak area ratio of Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ (0.93:1) ... no O_L is observed in NiFe LDH-Cl⁻. More O_ads content can be found in NiFe LDH-Cl⁻.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ C_dl = 4.0 mF cm⁻² (higher than NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ 2.8 mF cm⁻² and NiFe LDH-F⁻ 2.7 mF cm⁻²), indicating more exposed active sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the C_dl value of NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ (4.0 mF cm⁻²) is significantly higher, indicating more exposed active sites. Compared with NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ (2.8 mF cm⁻²) and NiFe LDH-F⁻ (2.7 mF cm⁻²).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ shows γ-NiOOH formation (E_g at ~480 cm⁻¹, A_1g at ~565 cm⁻¹) at low potential 0.35 V vs Hg/HgO, Area_565/Area_480 = 55.2%:44.8%, no β-FeOOH detected.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ completes the surface reconstruction at a low potential of 0.35 V ... the fitted values of Area_565/Area_480 for ... NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ are 55.2%:44.8% ... the less active β-FeOOH cannot be detected during the reconstruction process of NiFe LDH-Cl⁻.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ charge transfer resistance R_ct = 0.6 Ω (lower than NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ 1.7 Ω and NiFe LDH-F⁻ 20.0 Ω).
nodes.evidence_snippet: NiFe LDH-Cl⁻ has lower charge transfer resistance (R_ct, 0.6 Ω) and faster charge transfer compared to NiFe LDH-CO₃²⁻ (1.7 Ω) and NiFe LDH-F⁻ (20.0 Ω) during the OER process.
